samples.sourceText: Moran's eye measures global spatial autocorrelation. Get a sort GI star identifies local clusters geographically weighted regression allows relationships to vary across space. Landsat imagery can inform GOAI models, but spatial heterogeneity.

samples.sourceText: Crisp air canine can modify a targeted DNA sequence. Epigenetics studies changes in gene regulation. RNA polymerase synthesizes RNA during transcription. A transcription factor binds regulatory DNA and changes gene expression.
